title: Drawing-control training
passage:
Engineering training memo

Friday’s session introduces the new drawing-control workflow. It is intended for employees who create, review, or release engineering drawings, including purchasing staff who send drawings to suppliers. No CAD software experience is required.

Participants should bring a laptop and one example of a drawing-change request. Please remove customer names and other confidential details from the example. The session will demonstrate how to identify the current revision and how to withdraw obsolete copies. It will not teach three-dimensional modelling.

The recording and practice files will be available on the internal learning site the next day.
passageZh:
工程訓練備忘錄

星期五的課程介紹新的圖面管制流程，對象為製作、審核或發行工程圖面的人員，也包括將圖面寄給供應商的採購同仁。不需要 CAD 軟體經驗。

參加者應帶筆記型電腦及一份圖面變更申請範例。範例中的客戶名稱及其他機密資訊請先移除。課程會示範如何辨識目前版本及撤回過時副本，不會教授三維建模。

隔天可在內部學習網站取得錄影與練習檔案。
